concerns.text: SC-001 and SC-002 are identical: 'The difference in buffer cycles required to reach [deferred] accuracy between CAP and Static variants is measured against the baseline static convergence curve.' The spec fails to distinguish the two specific accuracy thresholds (50% and 80%) mentioned in the Methodology sketch and User Story 3, creating ambiguity in what exactly is being measured for each criterion.

The assumption regarding the 'consistently rejected' threshold ($psilon$) states it is 'set to a fixed value of 0.1 ([deferred] probability)'. This is contradictory: a value cannot be both 'fixed' and '[deferred]'. The spec should either commit to the 0.1 value as a design decision or mark the threshold itself as [deferred] to be determined during implementation, rather than mixing the two states.
